description: This file is a shell script that configures GRE tunnels, network interfaces, and system events related to hotspot and GRE setup. It includes variable definitions, functions for creating tunnels, managing syscalls, and network configurations, along with execution logic based on input commands.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes snooper sysevents by enabling circuit and remote features.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters from the PSM database, such as remote endpoints and bridge configurations.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates and configures GRE tunnel interfaces, adds network bridges, and attaches interfaces for hotspot functionality.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Sets various sysevents related to hotspot keepalive settings, primary and secondary endpoints, and policies.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Configures iptables rules for forwarding and NAT related to the hotspot.

calls: ip link add gretap0 type gretap remote `sysevent get hotspotfd-tunnelEP` local "`ifconfig -a eth0 | grep inet | grep -v inet6 | tr -s " " | cut -d ":" -f2 | cut -d " " -f1`" ttl 255 dev $WAN_IF
